MTG-269 reproduced the owned-SSH cancellation defect on 2026-11-09 using the schema-13 compatible Etude checkout etude.ad319b-show-live-progress (0.2.14). Run curriculum-held-out-707e62cad5fe-r3, attempt ab69a427b4a1, session c24c6c598b42, owned pool mini remained renting despite cancel_requested_at 2026-11-07T00:03:10Z. SSH confirmed the remote session directory was absent and no worker was running. A scoped mini scheduler tick left it renting: Scheduler._observe returns after find() is None when an owned session has no rental deadline. Calling _end_session also could not finish because ssh._BOOT's end branch returns no timestamp whenever receipt is absent, even if boot-claim is absent.

Operational recovery, authorized for this canceled allocation: under the existing mini lock, a process-local transport correction restricted that early return to absent receipt AND existing boot-claim. The existing remote DirectoryJournal.end then wrote its own shutdown receipt; _end_session retained final diagnostics and settled the run as cancelled at $0. No database deletion, fabricated start receipt, persistent SDK edit, or other-pool operation. Preserve uncertainty when boot-claim exists; this recovery was specific to an absent startup.

Published immutable receipt in Manabot's artifact store: r2://manabot/; SHA-256 1f8e914002b75f032f5d38a24b9477a3c78d6791b606b8123caeb33933f4d060, 12336 bytes. Logical path experiments/data/search-mirror-v2/reconciliation/curriculum-cancellation-repaired.json. It includes before/after status, exact transport replacement, and retained launcher diagnostics. Related study: loopflow://manabot/task/MTG-269. This is additional reproduction evidence for EXP-13, not authority for new paid validation or a request to start its graph.
